_comment: First half of the interrupt-* pair. turn:1 starts a long shell_exec (sleep 15, gated -> the runner auto-approves it). Run interrupt-followup against the same -session while the sleep is still running: turn.go cancels the in-flight tool, folds the follow-up in as a user message, and the next scripted response (added by interrupt-followup) acts on it. See interrupt-followup.expect.sh.
